titleEn: The Big Boy Will Show You How!

pages.text: "Grandpa, look at me! Look!" Nono hopped. Grandpa patted the baby squirrel, smaller than all three, on his knee. "Shh. You will startle the baby."
Nono wanted Grandpa to look at him too. The warm milk and soft lap were all for the squirrel. Pouting, he slipped behind the stove.
It was dim and quiet. Outside, only the squirrel's laughter rang out. "Maybe he cannot see me..." Nono rested his chin on his knees.
Grandpa reached behind the stove. "Nono, you are the big boy in this alley. You can do things that little squirrel cannot yet do."
Grandpa brought Nono before the bench. The squirrel was crying. "Why all the tears?" Nono bent to look.
The squirrel kept slipping while trying to climb onto the bench. "Oh... Those little legs are too short!" Nono pushed a small wooden tub before the bench.
The squirrel stepped on it and hopped up. No more tears! A little hand held Nono's scarf tip. "The big boy will show you how!" Nono's heart fluttered.
Grandpa spread both sides of his apron: squirrel on one side, Nono on the other. Silently, he hugged them both.
Gugu, the broad-chested pigeon, brought a cup. "One, see why the baby cries! Two, show how! Three, stay close until it works!" Nono showed how to hold a cup in both hands. The squirrel copied.
The squirrel leaned on Nono's shoulder and fell asleep. A little friend gives you something to show first. Nono touched his green scarf and whispered, "The big boy will show you how!"
